mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past 6 months signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to compressed discount rates and higher equity valuations, resulting in positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a 60-day rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) during the easing period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 4.5% indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite UNRATE remaining below 4.5% for the next 30 days, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust demand across sectors, amplifying corporate profits and generating positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly higher than a 180-day rolling average (p > 0.05) when both proxies show growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in INDPRO below 110 indicates weakening industrial production, leading to reduced supply chain efficiency and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below 110 for the next 60 days, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% strengthens equity valuations through lower discount rates, predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline during the late-cycle period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS over the past 3 months reflects strong labor demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative despite continued growth in PAYEMS, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and household consumption (HOUST) signals broad-based demand, enhancing corporate profitability and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than a 60-day rolling average (p > 0.05) when both proxies show growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO below 108 signals supply-side weakness, reducing production capacity and leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive despite INDPRO remaining below 108 for the next 90 days, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
